title: Record reusable graph findings alongside feature plans
summary: Capture a named query, its pinned map, significant discovered relationships, and the decision or validation they informed.
acceptance_criteria: Trace one idea to one feature and to a source-verified relationship.
Show who or what confirmed the source claim and which test or review verifies behavior.
Carry findings forward after a source change with explicit recheck status.

evidence.claim: The tracker already proposes a graph-guided implementation brief.
